scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mcai/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/render/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/tools/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/interop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/agent/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.desktop:smoke: pnpm --filter @architect/desktop build && cd apps/desktop && npx --no-install electron . --smoke
scripts.desktop:shot: pnpm --filter @architect/desktop build && cd apps/desktop && npx --no-install electron . --demo --capture /tmp/architect-gui.png
scripts.desktop:settings-shot: pnpm --filter @architect/desktop build && cd apps/desktop && npx --no-install electron . --demo --open-settings --capture /tmp/architect-settings.png
scripts.desktop:gui-smoke: pnpm --filter @architect/desktop build && cd apps/desktop && npx --no-install electron . --demo --gui-smoke
